title: Approve the standing W45 to W52 plan: channels, cadence and the gate rhythm
why: Every go-live from 2 November names this plan as its parent, so nothing signed goes live until he approves it once.
exact_payload:
Standing plan, W45 to W52 (2 November to 27 December 2026)

Aim: new publication subscribers a week from organic posts and shares, zero paid. The weekly targets come from the ladder in docs/NORTH_STAR.md: W45 86, W46 162, W47 271, W48 424, W49 636, W50 925, W51 1,312, W52 1,826.

Channels and cadence:
- substack (home.makeyourmindup.ai): the three pieces a week keep their editorial rhythm, follow.the.money on Monday, under.the.hood on Wednesday, mind.the.gap on Friday. Growth adds no article.
- substack-notes (his Substack profile, @mindmakerlive): up to two Notes a day, as he signs them.
- threads (@krishraja1): one a day, in his own warm personal voice.
- x and tiktok (@therealkrisho): one useful post a day each where an approved native edition exists, in his personal voice.
- instagram (makeyourmind.up), facebook and youtube: one useful post a day each where an approved native edition exists, in the publication's editorial voice; Instagram and Facebook go out as a pair.
- linkedin: unscheduled drafts only. He makes every final click. No daily quota.
A slot with no approved edition is recorded as missing, never filled with unapproved creative or a duplicate.

Gate rhythm:
- G-A, Sunday, up to 15 minutes: the week's Notes, Threads and evergreen slots as one go-live naming this plan; a payload over 8,000 characters splits into go-lives that come one after another.
- G-B, Monday, Wednesday and Friday, up to 5 minutes each: one piece's batch across channels, once Content Engine's checked package arrives.
- G-X, express, up to 2 minutes: an approved idea joins the go-live already waiting; at most one a day.
- Check-ins on Sunday, with the What-Works ledger, and on Wednesday: how the week stands against its target, measured where it can be.

Production: Content Engine makes every edition except Notes and memes, which the Canva lane makes. Growth packages, delivers and measures.

Measurement: Substack's growth sources are the number. GA4 per post comes through Control Center on utm_content. Each post gets a verdict at its judge window: a Note at 24 hours; LinkedIn, X and Threads at 48 hours; a Reel, Short or TikTok at 72 hours; subscriber impact at 7 days.

Walls: nothing goes live without his yes on that exact go-live. Spend stays 0. No comments, follows, messages or setting changes.

His time: 20 minutes a weekday and 30 on Sunday, gates first.

How it closes: each week's go-lives name this plan. His no on this plan, or on any check-in, stops it.
